title: Solar Net Metering Pakistan 2026: NEPRA NEM 3.0, Net Billing Transition, DISCO Application Process & PKR Economics — Complete Buyer Guide
summary_html: Complete 2026 guide to solar net metering in Pakistan: NEM 3.0 net billing vs NEM 2.0 comparison, per-DISCO capacity limits and fees, IEC 62116 anti-islanding requirements, UR-1 TOU tariff economics, and 7 common application mistakes — with PKR price tables for 3kW–30kW systems.
